items.title: Force newest lock file format (revision = 3, upload-time=...)
items.reason: Tracks the same mixed-uv-version problem: older developers' binaries change the lockfile revision, while a pinned pre-commit uv does not enforce the newest format. It explicitly asks to check the format and revision. Closed on 2026-05-27 with the maintainer recommendation to use --refresh. Its proposed remedy rewrites the file; the new report emphasizes non-writing CI validation.

items.title: Refresh lockfile when `--refresh` is provided (astral-sh/uv#15991)
items.reason: Merged on 2025-09-23. Makes --refresh force resolution and supports --refresh --locked, failing only when the resulting lockfile changes. Since --check is equivalent to --locked and lockfile equality includes revision, this supplies an existing non-writing check for revision changes, although it also refreshes metadata and checks other differences.

items.title: Prevent older uv versions from downgrading the lockfile revision
items.reason: Companion report describes the same revision 5-to-3 downgrade and exact frozen-discovery error. Its requested behavior differs: refuse writes by an older uv binary unless explicitly forced, rather than validate the revision with a newer binary in CI.

items.title: Add `--force` flag to `uv lock` for lockfile format migration
items.reason: Proposed a dedicated format-migration flag for astral-sh/uv#15220. Closed unmerged on 2026-05-27 after maintainers pointed to --refresh and found insufficient justification for another flag. Relevant design precedent, but its write-oriented flag explicitly conflicted with --check.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged PRs using authenticated gh. Separately searched revision validation (--check-revision, --check-latest-revision, lock/check/revision), downgrades (revision/downgrade and mixed-version format enforcement), and the exact 'Frozen lockfile discovery requires' error. Expanded to latest format, schema validation, strict checks, backward compatibility, pre-commit enforcement, and refresh-based fixes. Direct PR searches returned no matches; followed issue comments and timeline references to inspect astral-sh/uv#15757, astral-sh/uv#15994, astral-sh/uv#19217, and astral-sh/uv#19579, including maintainer feedback. Also inspected astral-sh/uv#13738, astral-sh/uv#11319, and astral-sh/uv#15997. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#16839: its false-positive dry-run changes concern marker comparison, not revision enforcement. astral-sh/uv#11319 concerns recording the generating uv version, not validating the lockfile revision. Checked current source, documentation, and existing tests; found no evidence of a regression in --check --refresh.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#15220 already tracks enforcing the newest lockfile format in pre-commit when contributors use different uv versions. The new report emphasizes non-writing CI validation, but the existing --check --refresh combination provides that workflow through astral-sh/uv#15994. A dedicated revision-only interface can be discussed in the existing thread. Ordinary checks intentionally accept compatible older revisions; no regression in the refresh-based check is established. astral-sh/uv#22911 is related but requests a different write-prevention policy.
summary: astral-sh/uv#15220 is the closest existing discussion. Merged astral-sh/uv#15994 enables --check --refresh for non-writing validation; astral-sh/uv#22911 separately proposes preventing downgrades.
draft_response:
You can use `uv lock --check --refresh` in CI with the uv version you want to enforce. It re-resolves and fails without rewriting `uv.lock` if the result differs, including its revision. This also refreshes dependency metadata and checks other lockfile changes, so it is broader than a revision-only check.

Let's consolidate this with astral-sh/uv#15220, where `--refresh` is the recommended approach. If you need a revision-only check without re-resolution, please describe that constraint there. You can also set `tool.uv.required-version` to reject older uv versions; preventing revision downgrades directly is discussed in astral-sh/uv#22911.
